plugins.name: dev-kit
plugins.description: Development conventions toolkit — Python (py-script/py-project), HTML/CSS/JS (FLOCSS, debug-fab, logging, mock), Next.js 16 App Router (implement/plan), and YAML. Reference auto-injection via PreToolUse(Edit/Write/MultiEdit/Read) gated by DEV_KIT_PYTHON / DEV_KIT_HTML / DEV_KIT_NEXT env opt-in; PostToolUse tsc check gated by DEV_KIT_NEXT_TS_CHECK.

plugins.name: claude-kit
plugins.description: Toolkit for authoring Claude Code instruction files — CLAUDE.md, path-scoped rules, and skills

plugins.name: work
plugins.description: Hook-based project lifecycle management — injects PR task context on every prompt, reminds task updates on stop, manages worktrees (toggle via WORK_USE_WORKTREE), and guards force-operations (toggle via WORK_GUARD). Protected branches customizable via WORK_PROTECTED_BRANCHES (comma-separated, default master,main,develop).

plugins.name: ref-inject
plugins.description: Attaches a reference auto-injection mechanism to a plugin (new or existing). /ref-inject:apply copies a PreToolUse hook that injects edit-path-matched references (required full-body, optional pointer) using a TTL-based per-session YAML token. Injection part only — plugin.json/CLAUDE.md/marketplace are plugin-creator's job.
